integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard topological-entropy factor, subsystem, and product formulas. No finite computation is used to infer an infinite statement.
limitations: The theorem is for compact forward-invariant subsets and ordinary topological entropy; no exact claim is made for non-invariant local Bowen/packing entropies or other geometric measure strata. Historical priority outside the inspected literature remains a residual risk.
title: Exact entropy of finite-atomic strata in the induced measure system
